# ionhour_regions (Data Source)

The probe regions this Ionhour environment serves, for `ionhour_check.config.regions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ionhour_regions" "all" {}

# Probe from every enabled region (the plan caps the count).
resource "ionhour_check" "everywhere" {
  name       = "Homepage from everywhere"
  project_id = ionhour_project.payments.id
  config = {
    url     = "https://www.example.com/"
    regions = slice(data.ionhour_regions.all.ids, 0, min(3, length(data.ionhour_regions.all.ids)))
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the enabled regions, in API order.
- `regions` (Attributes List) Every active region, in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether checks can use the region.
- `flag` (String) Flag emoji.
- `id` (String) Region id, as used in `config.regions`.
